fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Up to 40 characters, so the title fits the card on every screen.

validation.customErrorMsg: Keep the title to 40 characters at most.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Style
fields.description: Cover: full-screen image with items as colour swatches (Thumbnail = swatch). Cover sections in a row get a switch; give each a View name.

fields.name: classes_view-tabs
fields.label: Show the Views as Tabs
fields.description: Cover only. Set on the first view; the Cover sections right after it become tabs on this screen.

fields.name: label
fields.label: View name
fields.description: Cover only: this view's name on the switch, e.g. Exterior. Up to 16 characters.

validation.customErrorMsg: Keep the view name to 16 characters at most.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Button link
fields.description: Cover only, optional: a button at the bottom right, e.g. to the car configurator.

fields.name: linkText
fields.label: Button text
fields.description: Cover only: the button's text, e.g. Build your own. Up to 24 characters.

validation.customErrorMsg: Keep the button text to 24 characters at most.

fields.name: media_thumbnail
fields.label: Thumbnail
fields.description: Required: the item needs its thumbnail.

fields.name: media_image
fields.label: Showcase image
fields.description: Required: the item needs its showcase image.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Up to 40 characters, so the title fits the card on every screen.

validation.customErrorMsg: Keep the title to 40 characters at most.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Up to 160 characters; longer text is shortened. A paragraph, or a heading when the description is the item's caption.

fields.name: hotspots
fields.label: Hotspots (+ points)
fields.description: Up to 8 bullets: x, y | TITLE | description (40 / 200 characters). x, y = % from bottom-left; drag in preview. Cover: link TITLE to its photo.
